citation.concept: TURBOCORE FH and FG Turbine Fuel Water Separation Technology

canonical.definition: TURBOCORE is the ELIMFILTERS turbine-style fuel/water separation technology exclusively for approved FH and FG series systems.
canonical.systems:
Fuel Cleanliness Protection; approved FH and FG turbine-style separator systems only.

PRODUCTS
FUEL_TURBINE family: 900FH, 902FH, 1000FH, 1002FH turbine housings; 2010/2020/2040 PM/SM/TM replacement elements.

BOUNDARY
TURBOCORE must not be assigned to standard non-turbine separator filters. HYDROCORE must not be assigned to FH or FG turbine systems.
canonical.failure_impact: Incorrect housing, element-series, sealing or stage assignment can compromise the intended FH/FG turbine flow path, water-management boundary and particulate-control function, increasing downstream contamination exposure and fitment risk.
canonical.related_standards: ASTM D6304: water content determination in petroleum products | ISO 12937: water determination in petroleum products. Product-level water-separation efficiency or flow claims require validated evidence for the specific approved TURBOCORE configuration.
canonical.related_technologies:
SYNTAPORE governs plain diesel-fuel particulate filtration. HYDROCORE governs approved standard non-turbine fuel/water separators, including drain and transparent-bowl configurations.

RELATED_FAMILIES
FUEL_TURBINE: Turbine Series FH/FG housings and 2010/2020/2040 replacement elements governed by TURBOCORE™.
canonical.industrial_role: TURBOCORE provides the turbine-style fuel/water separation layer for approved FH and FG series systems within ELIMFILTERS Fuel Cleanliness Protection. It keeps turbine-specific housing geometry, staged flow routing and dedicated replacement-element architecture separate from standard non-turbine separator applications.
